# Aims

- Problems with data in research
- Seedcase: What do we do?
- Seedcase and ON-LiMiT (developing the data)
- Relevant operational and procedural aspects
- Future plans

# Problems with data in research

::: notes
How many have done data analysis at some point in their career? Or who have
talked with people who do data analysis and hear them complain/get frustrated?
:::

## Have you ever...<br><br>spent way too much time getting data ready for analysis? {.center}

## Have you ever...<br><br>had no idea what a particular column name meant? {.center}

## Have you ever...<br><br>had questions about data that only past researchers could answer? {.center}

## Problems with data in research {.center}

::: {.incremental}
- Data processing and cleaning takes far too long
- Data is rarely (and often poorly) documented
:::

# Seedcase

<https://seedcase-project.org>

## What do we do? {.center}

::: {.incremental}
- Use practices from software development lifecycle and data engineering
- Develop FAIR-compliant data (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable)
- Reproducibly create usable data from raw data
- Extract and display metadata on a website
- Build formal, versioned packages of data
- Develop software tools to simplify work in a broader sense
- Build data packages with collaborators (ON-LiMiT and DP-Next)
:::

# Seedcase and ON-LiMiT

## From raw data to analysis-ready {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: onlimit-data-package

flowchart LR
  redcap[("REDCap")]
  myfood24[("MyFood24")]
  others[("...<br>other<br>sources")]

  package_source["Data package<br>development:<br>metadata and<br>data"]
  data_package[(Data package)]
  website[Website with metadata]

  subset1[("Data subset:<br> Research analysis 1")]
  subset2[("Data subset:<br> Research analysis 2")]

  redcap & others & myfood24 -->
    package_source -->
    data_package & website

  data_package --> subset1 & subset2
```

## Building the critical metadata {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: metadata-lifecycle

flowchart TB
  raw[("Raw (meta)data<br>source")]
  new_version[Create<br>new version]
  data_package[(Data package)]
  website[Rebuild<br>website]

  subgraph metadata ["Steps for metadata"]
    extract[Extracting] ~~~
      clean[Cleaning]
    edit[Editing] ~~~
      check[Checking]
  end

  raw -->
    metadata -->
    new_version --> data_package & website

  new_version -->|repeat| metadata

  style metadata fill:none
```

## Raw-to-ready data {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: data-lifecycle

flowchart TB
  raw[("Raw data<br>source")]
  new_version[Create<br>new version]
  data_package[(Data package)]

  subgraph data ["Steps for data"]
    split[Splitting] ~~~
      join[Joining]
    clean[Cleaning] ~~~
      pivot[Pivoting]
    check[Checking]
  end

  raw -->
    data -->
    new_version -->
    data_package

  new_version -->|repeat| data

  style data fill:none
```

## Result: Reproducible, well-documented, and versioned data {.center}

. . .

```
feasibility-data_v1.0.0.zip/
├── datapackage.json
├── README.md
├── LICENSE.md
├── CHANGELOG.md
└── resources/
    ├── sociodemographics.parquet
    ├── ...
    └── blood.parquet
```

# Relevant operational and procedural aspects {.center}

::: {.incremental}
- Need strong coordination from end-to-end to create analysis-ready data
- Some things make sense for data collection---but not for later analysis (as we
  experienced in feasibility)
- Data package website as "first stop"<br>
  <https://onlimit-study.github.io/feasibility-data/>
:::

# Future plans

## Data request flow {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: request-flow

  subgraph researcher ["Researcher"]
    request_page["Data request<br>webpage"]
    request["Standardised request"]
  end
  subgraph data_manager ["Data manager"]
    create_subset["Run a single command"]
    subset_data[("Requested data<br>subset")]
  end

  request_page -->|Select columns<br>and rows| request
  request -->|Email<br>request| create_subset
  create_subset -->|Generate<br>subset| subset_data

  style researcher fill:none
  style data_manager fill:none
```
